verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government business-filing portal, which could offer batch filings, bulk searches, or bulk document retrieval, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only individual-item services: single-entity filings, name searches, certificate requests, and UCC lookups. The Premier Business Services account for frequent filers and shared staff payment is an adjacent convenience, not a documented way to act on many items at once.
